context: Port the validated standalone semantics narrowly: an update command with add/drop scope flags, mandatory reason, prevalidation, one transaction, and one audit event. Prove the live item9 scope can then be widened through the CLI.
description: The live BenchBox hosted tracker still uses its embedded schema and standalone todo-db intentionally rejects that schema. Add atomic audited only_modify/do_not_modify rule mutation to the embedded CLI so blocked items can be repaired without direct SQL.

preserves.behavior: All hosted tracker writes remain CLI-only and project state changes remain atomic.
Scope removals require explicit rationale and invalid/duplicate/conflicting changes roll back completely.
